precision_recall_and_unsupported_promoti.mechanism: precision, recall and F1 are computed from an exact match key the report states, and every value is recomputable from the true/false positive and false negative counts beside it; unsupported evidence promotion is counted separately with its numerator, denominator and offending claim ids, and is reported undefined rather than zero when no matched pair exists

table_figure_spans_included.mechanism: the corpus must ground at least one gold claim in a table cell and one in a figure caption, every span must satisfy the canonical SourceSpan schema with its text_hash recomputed from the verbatim bytes, and a claim whose text does not appear in a cited span is refused rather than scored
